tool_input.prompt:
Search the codebase for the stepper input component used for diagram x/y coordinates in the Design app. The component renders an input with id like "compose.sketchpad.app.design.panel.details.section.connection.x" and "compose.sketchpad.app.design.panel.details.section.connection.y".

I need to understand:
1. How the stepper component handles value changes (onChange, onValueChange, onBlur, onKeyDown with Enter, etc.)
2. Whether it uses React's controlled input pattern (value + onChange) or uncontrolled (defaultValue)
3. What events trigger a value commit (Enter key, blur, etc.)

Look in:
- /workspaces/semio/compose/sketchpad/sketchpad/ directory for the Design panel components
- Search for "connection.x" or "connection.y" or "stepper" patterns in the Design panel

Return:
- The file path and approximate line numbers of the stepper component definition
- How the value is committed (what events/callbacks trigger the actual data update)
- Whether it uses a standard input onChange or a custom mechanism
